title: Pyroclasm clears the chump blockers, then the Tusker is lethal
briefing: P2 is at 3 with three small untapped blockers (Grizzly Bears, Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic). P1 has Kalonian Tusker (3/3) and Pyroclasm. Attacking first just feeds the Tusker a chump block. Pyroclasm first kills all three blockers and spares the Tusker, whose three damage is exactly lethal.

reference.analysis: Pyroclasm deals 2 to each creature: the Bears, Elves and Mystic die; the 3/3 Tusker survives. With no blockers the Tusker deals 3 at a player on 3. Attacking first lets any of the three blockers chump it.

lines.label: Cast Pyroclasm, then attack P2 with the Tusker
lines.why: No blockers left: 3 damage is lethal.

lines.label: Attack with the Tusker, hold Pyroclasm
lines.why: A chump block stops the damage and P2 survives.
